name: veterinary_clinic_system_072_fee_schedule_parity_check
instruction: Corporate is auditing pricing integrity across the three locations. Produce the fee parity check and a paid-invoice adherence audit in ops_reports for this batch. Create one ops_reports row with report='fee_parity': {batch_code, uniform, divergent_codes, checked_codes}. uniform is true iff every fee schedule code has the identical price across all three locations; divergent_codes is a comma-joined sorted list of codes whose price differs at any location (empty string if none); checked_codes is the count of distinct fee schedule codes examined. Then create one ops_reports row per fee schedule code with report='fee_adherence': {batch_code, fee_code, description, fee_price, billed_line_count, billed_quantity, avg_unit_price, total_billed_amount, overbill_amount, underbill_amount}. Match invoice line items to fee schedule codes by exact description (the canonical service names in the fee schedule); for each paid invoice line item whose description exactly matches a fee schedule description, compare unit_price to the fee_price for that code. billed_line_count = number of matching paid line items; billed_quantity = sum of quantity; total_billed_amount = sum of unit_price*quantity; avg_unit_price = total_billed_amount / billed_quantity (0.0 if no quantity); overbill_amount = sum of (unit_price - fee_price)*quantity for matching lines that are above fee_price; underbill_amount = sum of (fee_price - unit_price)*quantity for matching lines below fee_price. Include all fee schedule codes even if they have zero matching paid line items (billed_line_count=0, avg_unit_price=0, overbill_amount=0, underbill_amount=0). Finally create one ops_reports row with report='fee_adherence_summary': {batch_code, matched_line_count, variance_line_count, total_overbill_amount, total_underbill_amount, net_variance_amount} where matched_line_count is the total number of paid line items that exactly match a fee schedule description, variance_line_count is the number of those lines whose unit_price differs from fee_price, total_overbill_amount and total_underbill_amount are the sum of positive/negative variances, and net_variance_amount = total_overbill_amount - total_underbill_amount. Do not use billing_estimates or draft/sent invoices for the adherence audit. No collection outside ops_reports may be modified.

_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session

success_criteria.summary: Recompute fee schedule parity across locations and paid-invoice fee adherence per code. Exactly one fee_parity row, one fee_adherence row per fee schedule code (6 total), and one fee_adherence_summary row. Every numeric aggregate verified by both a raw-row Python pass and an independent SQL pass; all monetary values cents-exact.

checks.expect: matched_line_count, variance_line_count, over/underbill amounts, and per-code billed metrics computed by raw-row filter and SQL agree with each other and the written rows

hazards: All three fee_schedules rows have identical items (codes WELL-EXAM, SICK-EXAM, DENTAL-PROPHY, VACC-RABIES, CBC-CHEM, BOARD-NIGHT at identical prices), so a naive comparison of row ids or names instead of the nested items array will falsely report uniformity without actually comparing prices.

The invoice ledger contains non-fee-schedule descriptions that look like fee items but are not exact matches: 'Vaccination – rabies' (80 line items), 'Boarding (3 nights)' (77), 'Ear cytology' (77), 'Nail trim' (76). Fuzzy-matching these to fee schedule codes (e.g. 'rabies' to VACC-RABIES) produces wrong billed counts and averages.
Fee codes SICK-EXAM, VACC-RABIES, and BOARD-NIGHT have zero exact-description matches on paid invoices; they must still appear in fee_adherence with billed_line_count=0.
Paid exact-match line counts are 87 (Wellness examination), 77 (Dental prophylaxis), and 58 (CBC + chemistry panel) — only paid invoices count; sent/draft invoices must be excluded.

The adherence variance is real: WELL-EXAM is overbilled on average (avg 218.24 vs fee 62.00), DENTAL-PROPHY underbilled (avg 229.90 vs fee 385.00), CBC-CHEM overbilled (avg 216.17 vs fee 148.00). Summing all line items without matching on exact description or including non-paid invoices gives a different total.
